subject: Hospitality
title: Space Hotels
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Space Hotels.

hook.text: Orbital Reef and Axiom Space plan commercial space stations with hotel modules. A night in orbit may cost $35 million.

buildup.text: NASA has opened the International Space Station to private guests. Four tourists visited in 2022 via SpaceX.

discovery.text: Space hotel designers plan Earth-view windows, zero-gravity recreation, and gourmet meals adapted for microgravity.

twist.text: The physics of hospitality in space are brutal. Showers don't work. Crumbs float. Sleep requires strapping yourself in.

climax.text: Space tourism will start ultra-luxury and eventually scale down—like aviation went from millionaires to everyone.

punchline.text: First class was once planes. Next: orbit. Hospitality always follows the frontier.

quiz.question: How much might a night in a space hotel initially cost?
